newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish fixed bond minimum prices down at tender.
newsitem.headline: Polish fixed bond minimum prices down at tender.

text.p: The minimum price of Poland's 15-percent two-year fixed bond fell to 89.67 from 90.35 at the previous tender of similar bonds on May 7 and the ministry sold 531 million zlotys of the bonds, the central bank said.
The minimum price of the 12-percent five-year fixed bond fell to 79.15 from 79.59 and the ministry sold 263 million zlotys of the longer paper at Wednesday's joint 800 million zloty auction.
Full resluts of the auction available on NBPV and information about Polish debt on PLMINFIN.
